ResourceHeader.ResourceName: ICON Ion Velocity Meter (IVM) A In Situ Ions Data
ResourceHeader.AlternateName: IVM A In Situ Ions Data
ResourceHeader.Description: ICON In Situ Ions; 48-day windows of data from the L2.7 v08 product are collected into longitude, latitude, and local time bins. Mean and standard deviations of each parameter are reported in this file. The IVM consists of two planar thermal ion sensors, a retarding potential analyzer (RPA) and an ion drift meter (IDM).

Parameter.Name: Epoch time
Parameter.Description: Time corresponding to the middle of each 48 day average, in milliseconds since Jan 1 1970.

Parameter.Name: 48 day bins RPA
Parameter.Description: Dates used in each 48 day bin, in string format, in the format: 2017-05-27; data measured by the Retarding Potential Analyzer; from RPA flag used in all data products.

Parameter.Name: 48 day bins DM
Parameter.Description: Dates used in each 48 day bin, in string format, in the format: 2017-05-27; data measured by the Drift Meter; from DM flag used only in drifts (not in ion temperature, ion density, ion density O.

Parameter.Name: Ion Density
Parameter.Description: Mean value of ion density, taken over all good quality L2 datapoints in a 48-day time-span, as a function of longitude, latitude, time. Derived from ICON_L27_ION_DENSITY.

Parameter.Name: Ion Temperature
Parameter.Description: Mean value of ion temperature, taken over all good quality L2 datapoints in a 48-day time-span, as a function of longitude, latitude, time. Derived from ICON_L27_ION_TEMPERATURE.

Parameter.Name: Fraction of Total Plasma Number Density that is O+
Parameter.Description: Mean value of fraction of total plasma number density that is O+ taken over all good quality L2 datapoints in a 48-day time-span, as a function of longitude, latitude, time. Derived from FRACTIONAL_ION_DENSITY_O.

Parameter.Name: Binned Field-Aligned Ion Velocity
Parameter.Description: Mean value of field-aligned ion velocity, taken over all good quality L2 datapoints in a 48-day time-span, as a function of longitude, latitude, time. Derived from ION_VELOCITY_FIELD_ALIGNED.

Parameter.Name: Binned Meridional Ion Velocity
Parameter.Description: Mean value of meridional ion velocity, taken over all good quality L2 datapoints in a 48-day time-span, as a function of longitude, latitude, time. Derived from ION_VELOCITY_MERIDIONAL. Meridional ion velocity is the ion velocity along local magnetic meridional direction, perpendicular to geomagnetic field and within local magnetic meridional plane. The local meridional vector maps to vertical at the magnetic equator, positive is up.

Parameter.Name: Binned Zonal Ion Velocity
Parameter.Description: Mean value of zonal ion velocity, taken over all good quality L2 datapoints in a 48-day time-span, as a function of longitude, latitude, time. Derived from ION_VELOCITY_ZONAL.

Parameter.Name: Binned IVM Measured Ion Drifts along East
Parameter.Description: Mean value of IVM measured ion drifts along East direction, taken over all good quality L2 datapoints in a 48-day time-span, as a function of longitude, latitude, time. Derived from ION_VELOCITY_EAST.

Parameter.Name: Binned IVM Measured Ion Drifts along North
Parameter.Description: Mean value of IVM measured ion drifts along North direction, taken over all good quality L2 datapoints in a 48-day time-span, as a function of longitude, latitude, time. Derived from ION_VELOCITY_NORTH.

Parameter.Name: Binned IVM measured ion drifts along Up
Parameter.Description: Mean value of IVM measured ion drifts along up direction, taken over all good quality L2 datapoints in a 48-day time-span, as a function of longitude, latitude, time. Derived from ION_VELOCITY_UP.

Parameter.Name: Number of Data Points in the RPA measured data
Parameter.Description: Number of data points in each 48 day average data, measured by the Retarding Potential Analyzer (RPA), as a function of longitude, latitude, time.

Parameter.Name: Number of Data Points in the DM measured data
Parameter.Description: Number of data points in each 48 day average data, measured by the Drift Meter (DM) as a function of longitude, latitude, time.

Parameter.Name: Sigma Ion Density
Parameter.Description: 1 standard deviation of the good ion density values used to compute the mean, as a function of longitude, latitude, time.

Parameter.Name: Sigma Ion Temperature
Parameter.Description: 1 standard deviation of the good fraction of ion temperature values used to compute the mean, as a function of longitude, latitude, time.

Parameter.Name: Sigma Fraction of Total Plasma Number Density that is O+
Parameter.Description: 1 standard deviation of the good fraction of total plasma number density that is O+ values used to compute the mean, as a function of longitude, latitude, time.

Parameter.Name: Sigma Field-Aligned Ion Velocity
Parameter.Description: 1 standard deviation of the good ion field aligned ion velocity values used to compute the mean, as a function of longitude, latitude, time.

Parameter.Name: Sigma Meridional Ion Velocity
Parameter.Description: 1 standard deviation of the good ion meridional ion velocity values used to compute the mean, as a function of longitude, latitude, time.

Parameter.Name: Sigma Zonal Ion Velocity
Parameter.Description: Mean value of zonal ion velocity, taken over all good quality L2 datapoints in a 48-day time-span, as a function of longitude, latitude, time. Derived from ION_VELOCITY_ZONAL.

Parameter.Name: Sigma of Ion Drifts along East direction
Parameter.Description: 1 standard deviation of the good ion drifts along East direction values used to compute the mean, as a function of longitude, latitude, time.

Parameter.Name: Sigma of ion drifts along North direction
Parameter.Description: 1 standard deviation of the good ion drifts along North direction values used to compute the mean, as a function of longitude, latitude, time.

Parameter.Name: Sigma of ion drifts along Up direction
Parameter.Description: 1 standard deviation of the good ion drifts along Up direction values used to compute the mean, as a function of longitude, latitude, time.

Parameter.Name: Local Time Bin
Parameter.Description: Local time binned in 0.5 hour intervals, local time +/- 0.25 hours.

Parameter.Name: Latitude Bin
Parameter.Description: Latitude of the IVM data, binned in 5 degree intervals, latitude +/- 2.5 degrees. Derived from ICON_IVM-A_L27_Latitude.

Parameter.Name: Longitude Bin
Parameter.Description: Longitude of the O/N2 data, binned in 15 degree intervals, longitude +/- 7.5 degrees. Derived from ICON_L24_Disk_Longitude.
